results.title: Auth RLS Initialization Plan
results.description: Detects if calls to `current_setting()` and `auth.<function>()` in RLS policies are being unnecessarily re-evaluated for each row
results.detail: Table `aigc.members` has a row level security policy `member_profile_update` that re-evaluates current_setting() or auth.<function>() for each row. See [docs](https://supabase.com/docs/guides/database/postgres/row-level-security#call-functions-with-select) for more info.
